_doc: Mẫu con rối 2D Ama (docs/LESSON-ENGINE.md §4b). tags: at = chỉ số từ (0 = đầu câu) hoặc chữ của từ; kind = question|correct|wrong|explain|point|greet|proud|encourage|surprised (puppet.js KIND) hoặc expr/gest trực tiếp.

lines.text: Hi! I'm Ama, your English teacher.
You borrow something when you take it, and give it back later.
So, which one is right? Can you lend me your pen, or borrow me your pen?
If you got it wrong, that's okay.
You'll remember it next time. I'm proud of you!
